ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 37

2. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 18
   C. 7
   D. 6

3. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 6x
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 12x

4. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 1/4
   C. Cannot tell
   D. 1/2

5. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 16
   C. 32
   D. 55

6. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)

   D. 37

14. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)

   B. 2
   C. 49
   D. 1

15. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.7
   B. 27
   C. 27.6
   D. 33

16. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 9
   C. 81
   D. 40.5

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
